Lawn Sign

Lightweight, durable, and weather-resistant corrugated plastic signs ideal for indoor and outdoor use. A cost-effective choice for real estate, political, yard, event, construction, and promotional signage. Available in 4mm thickness and with/out step stakes. Suitable for up to 12–18 months outdoors and 2+ years indoors.

Lightweight, durable, corrugated plastic yard signs built for real estate, political, event, construction, and promotional use. They hold up outdoors for roughly 12–18 months and even longer indoors, making them a low-cost option for anyone who needs visible signage on a lawn, at a job site, or along a street.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long do lawn signs last outdoors?

The 4mm corrugated plastic is rated for roughly 12–18 months of outdoor use and 2+ years indoors, per the manufacturer.

Do the signs come with stakes?

Step stakes are available as an option — select with or without stakes when configuring your order.

What sizes are available?

Nine sizes, from a compact 12 x 24 up to a large 24 x 96 sign. Pick your size in the configurator above.

Can Cornerstone design my lawn sign artwork?

Yes, design services are available as an add-on per side during checkout.

What's the minimum order?

2 signs, with many quantity breaks available up to 100.
